title: Geometry of Continued Fractions — Faces of sails
exact_target: Classify lattice simplices that contain no lattice points except their vertices, allowing every dimension and identifying simplices related by an invertible integer affine change of coordinates.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1900004 (AMR-018-0004). CC BY 4.0.
Oleg Karpenkov, \emph{Open problems in geometry of continued fractions}, 2017. Problem 4 and its surrounding definitions and remarks.
